original: Let $A\in\mathcal{M}_{3}({\mathbb{Z}})$ be a non-scalar matrix. We have either $\#\operatorname{C}(A,{\mathbb{Z}};H)\asymp H^{3}$ or $\#\operatorname{C}(A,{\mathbb{Z}};H)\asymp H^{5}$ . Moreover, $\#\operatorname{C}(A,{\mathbb{Z}};H)\asymp H^{5}$ if and only if $A$ is similar to either $\alpha I_{2}\oplus\beta I_{1}$ $(\alpha\neq\beta)$ or $J_{2}(\alpha)\oplus J_{1}(\alpha)$ , where $J_{n}(\alpha)$ denotes the Jordan matrix of order $n$ corresponding to to eigenvalue $\alpha$ .
type: ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℤ), (∀ (k : ℤ), A ≠ k • 1) → (((fun H => ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_11287_centralizer_count A ↑H)) =Θ[Filter.atTop] fun H => ↑H ^ 3) ∨ (fun H => ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_11287_centralizer_count A ↑H)) =Θ[Filter.atTop] fun H => ↑H ^ 5) ∧ (((fun H => ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_11287_centralizer_count A ↑H)) =Θ[Filter.atTop] fun H => ↑H ^ 5) ↔ (∃ α β, α ≠ β ∧ IsConj (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom ℂ)) !![α, 0, 0; 0, α, 0; 0, 0, β]) ∨ ∃ α, IsConj (A.map ⇑(Int.castRingHom ℂ)) !![α, 1, 0; 0, α, 0; 0, 0, α])
